notes.text: Turn 1 room choice happens before the draw, so I pick blind to my hand. Taking Security Turnstile: both its challenges can pay out, two rewards. Shaft then Drone to the bottom so I see the Drone last.
Drone revealed in the middle. Passing over it: Exhaust resets at Ascend, so every room cleared before the Stairwell is a free reward. Gray is at 8 live though, so I am watching stamina for the Drone.

Blind choice bit me: after entering the Shaft I drew Reckless Swing + 2 Charge, which beats the Drone's Oomph 8 this turn. The room choice is made before the draw, so it cannot react to the hand. Fine on floor 1, but it makes the choice weaker than it looks.

Red holds Reckless Swing + 2 Charge, a guaranteed Oomph 9 next turn whatever is drawn. So I take the last Shaft for 2 more rewards and leave the Drone as the forced last card. Held cards make the blind choice informed.
Floor 1 done in 6 turns, all 6 rooms cleared, 10 rewards taken. On floor 1-2 Exhaust is free because Ascend resets it, so the room choice reduces to: clear every Room, Stairwell last.

Zen Mode: Gray played Pick The Lock paying Duck Under + IKKF and both stayed in hand ('Zen Mode stops it: Gray Exhausts nothing'). So with Zen Mode in play the payers are not moved at all, they remain usable. Rulebook says pay = move cards to Exhaust; Zen card says 'you don't exhaust cards'. Is a payer that is not exhausted meant to stay in hand, or go to discard? Staying in hand makes Gray's whole hand nearly free.
Zen Mode turned Gray's 4-card hand into S12 for 1 Exhaust (Zen's own payer). Payers stay in hand, so each payer can pay again. This is the strongest card in the run by far.

Drone Scramble 8 scrap: Gray's only choices were good cards. The weak ones (Duck Under) were in the play zone or Exhaust, and Outcome comes before Cleanup, so a scrap reward rarely reaches the cards you used to clear the room. Declined.
CLI friction: card rewards use 'take', but Good Stuff picks use 'choose'. 'take Coil Of Cable' was refused. Two verbs for the same 'pick one of 3' act.

Choosing Gears & Glitch over the Hydroponics Bay (S11 for Good Stuff only, Flee gives Bad Stuff that survives Ascend). Since the Stairwell can be entered whenever it is revealed, the choice lets me skip a bad-value room for good. The Bay is never faced.

Riot Shield returned to hand at the start of Outcome, printed before the room's rewards. Card says 'at the end of the Outcome phase'. Order matters: it is now in hand and offered to the Turret's scrap. Question: should it return after the outcomes resolve?

Floor 5 turn 1: Monolith Core is in the first reveal. Nothing on floor 5 carries forward past a win, so the Rooms are only worth it as practice. Fleeing the Core costs Exhaust 5 each from decks of 27/31. Entering the Core blind on turn 1 of the floor.
Victory turn 23, zero Flees. The Core fell on the first turn of floor 5 to a blind entry. Sharing Is Caring + two Quick Vaults + Momentum Shift gave 11+ usable cards. Floor 5's Rooms were never seen.
